rv.q: The Rodgers and Hammerstein classic marks a heart-warming end to Elizabeth Newman’s tenure as artistic director at Pitlochry Festival Theatre

Scotland’s “Theatre in the Hills” is one of the loveliest places to see any play, and if the Perthshire Highlands might not bear that close a resemblance to the Austrian Alps, then they still make for a stunning backdrop. Not that The Sound of Music needs any special pleading, of course.
